521:t_021:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「I presumed, on my own, that you would understand everything without my putting it into words.」

521:t_021:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...You have too many illusions about women.」

521:t_021:9.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Just as you want to rely on a woman, remember that there are women who want to rely on you.」

521:t_021:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Even if she's the sort the world calls an Iron Lady.」

521:t_021:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「Will you walk with me, $$ハマーン$$?」

521:t_021:12.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I have been waiting all this time for you to say that.」

521:t_022:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「Colonel $$シャア$$. If you've settled things, come over here right away.」

521:t_022:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「We've received word from $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$. $$アマルガム$$ has started moving to destroy the world.」

521:t_022:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「An enigmatic organization with ties to the $$新地球皇国$$, separate from $$ネオ・ジオン$$... $$アマルガム$$...」

521:t_022:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「But $$フル・フロンタル$$ has been in contact with them since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

521:t_022:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Could the war with the Empire that $$フロンタル$$ started to mention be...!?」

521:t_022:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「...Were $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s moves in space meant to draw our eyes away from $$アマルガム$$...?」

521:t_023:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Not yet! I can't go down right before the Colonel's eyes!」

521:t_024:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain $$アンジェロ$$! You're still going on like that!」

521:t_024:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Silence, $$バナージ・リンクス$$! The Colonel is everything to me!」

521:t_024:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You wouldn't understand! When I was in a darkness where I thought being born was a mistake, the Colonel saved me!」

521:t_024:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Blindly believing in $$フル・フロンタル$$ like that is narrowing your possibilities!」

521:t_025:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You can't let yourself be bound by what's in front of you! If you lived more freely, people could... go further!」

521:t_026:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The light of the $$サイコ・フレーム$$ has changed...!」

521:t_026:2.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Huh...! The spare shield is moving on its own!?」

521:t_027:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Impossible! What is this power!?」

521:t_027:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Did he control the shields with the $$サイコ・フィールド$$!?」

521:t_027:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「($$バナージ$$'s $$ニュータイプ$$ ability awakens, the $$ユニコーン$$ evolves, and at the same time the $$ユニコーン$$ makes $$バナージ$$ evolve...)」

521:t_027:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「(So this is... the true meaning... of the $$ガンダム$$...)」

521:t_027:4.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I won't forgive you...! I won't forgive you, $$バナージ$$!」

521:t_027:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「You, who denied the Colonel, I will kill with my own hands without fail!」

521:t_028:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「He's... still in the darkness even now...」

521:t_029:0.en:
$$ヒル$$
「I can't let $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s flagship go down! Fall back!」

521:t_100:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! You must not be the one to lead the world!」

521:t_100:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The world rejected the $$時の牢獄$$ because it wants a future!」

521:t_100:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「If despair awaits beyond that, then it is a proper leader's duty to steer people away from it.」

521:t_100:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What we must do is overcome it! I can't hand the world over to you, who can't understand that!」

521:t_101:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$, $$ハマーン・カーン$$. I will purge the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ defectors together.」

521:t_101:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The name $$ジオン$$ does not suit an organization led by you.」

521:t_101:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$... I can't entrust those who believe in $$ジオン$$ to you.」

521:t_101:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「I... no, we will save them...! The people of space and the people of Earth alike!」

521:t_101:4.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Only one who is prepared to make himself the vessel can do that, $$シャア$$!」

521:t_101:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't flatter yourself, $$フロンタル$$! Don't think a vessel of your caliber can take in people's feelings!」

521:t_102:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$. You at least, come to me.」

521:t_102:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No! You're not the Colonel, and you're not someone who can lead this world!」

521:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't think a man who can't show people a future or dreams deserves the name $$赤い彗星$$!」

521:t_103:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$ is prepared to fight for the future of peace, even if it means shedding blood.」

521:t_103:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I cannot tolerate lives being lost by following such a dreamer.」

521:t_103:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「How to use a life is for each person to decide. I don't need your permission.」

521:t_103:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I will use my life to fight those who block the future.」

521:t_104:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「It seems you said needless things and made $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$ hesitate.」

521:t_104:1.en:
$$シン$$
「You're calling worrying about a friend needless!?」

521:t_104:2.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「A pity. He was destined to become my comrade.」

521:t_104:3.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't decide how $$レイ#pt136$$ lives on your own! $$レイ#pt136$$ decided of his own will to fight alongside us!」

521:t_104:4.en:
$$シン$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$! I won't hand over the world or my precious friend to you!」

521:t_105:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$キラ・ヤマト$$. The boy $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$ hated most.」

521:t_105:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「No matter how much I'm hated, I will live...! And I'll fight for what I believe in!」

521:t_105:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I sympathize with your circumstances...! But that's no reason to forgive you!」

521:t_105:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have no desire for such things. But since you stand in my way, you will have to disappear.」

521:t_106:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$イノベイター$$. So that is the future of humanity that $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ dreamed of?」

521:t_106:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I am who I am. I can't even tell what $$イオリア$$ wished for.」

521:t_106:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「But I will fight those who would close off the future, by my own will!」

521:t_106:3.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then I will teach reality to you, who became a dreamer by gaining power beyond other men.」

521:t_107:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'd heard about you, but you really are one outrageous guy!」

521:t_107:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「So there's someone here who rides a $$ガンダム$$ too...!」

521:t_107:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This $$ダブルエックス$$ is my bond with $$ティファ$$... It's the very power that longs for the future!」

521:t_107:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's go, $$赤い彗星$$ knockoff! I'll show you how amazing the power of hope is!」

521:t_108:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Someone who can't picture the future can't lead everyone!」

521:t_108:1.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「You talk as if you know something about it.」

521:t_108:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The person I know always showed us the ideal we should strive for!」

521:t_108:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You can't do that, so you're not a vessel fit to carry the world!」

521:t_109:0.en:
$$フロンタル$$
「The pilot of this machine... has improved...!」

521:t_109:1.en:
$n
「Of course. Unlike some people I know, I'm trying to move forward, even if only little by little!」

521:t_109:2.en:
$n
「Let's go, $$フル・フロンタル$$! Before you get left behind by the times, I'll make you a relic of the past!」

521:t_110:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Out of my way, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$!」

521:t_110:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't think you, who sided with $$フロンタル$$ and the status quo, can beat me, who always looks ahead!」
